sentences.en: Acute febrile polyneuritis Acute febrile polyneuritis was one of six classes of polyneuropathy proposed by Ostler in 1892.

sentences.en: In 1918, Bradford et al described ' acute infective polyneuritis ' .
sentences.vi: Năm 1918, Bradford và cộng sự đã mô tả 'viêm đa dây thần kinh nhiễm trùng cấp tính'.
Còn được gọi là viêm đa dây thần kinh vô căn cấp tính.

sentences.en: Polyneuritis was clearly a word like morality that meant so many different things as to be absolutely meaningless.

sentences.en: All this stuff about polyneuritis was handy, thought Henry, but perhaps a little too neat.

sentences.en: Poliomyelitis and polyneuritis ( neuritis of multiple nerves ) result in paralysis with muscle wasting.

sentences.en: Conclusion The combined acupuncture and moxibustion therapy has a definite therapeutic effect on polyneuritis.
